title: TagDuel 2v2 Main Deck, Extra Deck and field-zone boundaries
scenarios: A classic four-seat TagDuel accepts a 20-card Main Deck and a 30-card Main Deck with five enabled Fusion cards in the Extra Deck. Both team fields retain exactly three Monster Zones, three Spell/Trap Zones and a separate Field Zone.
The same constructor rejects a 19-card Main Deck, a 31-card Main Deck containing an additional distinct enabled Normal monster, and an Extra Deck with six enabled Fusion cards.
invariants: Main Deck minimum is 20 and maximum is 30.
Each team has three Monster Zones and three Spell/Trap Zones.
Field Zone remains separate from the three Spell/Trap slots.
Current RULES_PROFILE hand limit remains six.
All four physical participants and card UIDs remain unique.
limits: Tests use real compiled TagDuel, rulesProfile and enabled card registry modules.
Main/Extra Deck fixtures use existing enabled cards; no collection or inventory mutation occurs.
No runtime, resolver, catalog manifest, allowlist, persistent database or player data is modified.
This verifies structural rules, not new card behavior.
No live Discord API session is performed.
command: npm run check && npm run build && node --test tests/tagDeckExtraAndZoneBoundaries2v2.test.cjs
